# Vertical overlay: Utilities

**Level:** NAICS 2022 sector 22 (parent vertical)
**CISA critical infrastructure sectors nested here:** Energy, Dams, Nuclear Reactors, Materials, and Waste, Water and Wastewater Systems
**Primary industry for Cris Santos Company:** NAICS 221122 Electric Power Distribution. Electric distribution utility serving residential and commercial customers.
**Primary system:** Distribution SCADA and outage management system

## Regulators and sector risk management agency
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC); North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) - ERO; Department of Energy (DOE CESER) - Energy SRMA; Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC); Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Water SRMA; Transportation Security Administration (TSA) - gas pipelines/LNG

## Primary regulation for the gap analysis (P03)
**NERC CIP Reliability Standards**, 16 U.S.C. 824o; NERC CIP-002 through CIP-015. The most mature, mandatory, auditable cyber regime among utilities (penalties up to FPA civil penalty limits, CMEP audits). Water utilities should instead use SDWA 1433 RRA; nuclear 10 CFR 73.54; gas pipelines TSA SD 2021-02 series.
Source: https://www.nerc.com/standards/reliability-standards/cip

## Sector context
- **Sensitive data:** CEII - Critical Energy/Electric Infrastructure Information (18 CFR 388.113); BES Cyber System Information (CIP-011); Safeguards Information (10 CFR 73.21-73.22); SSI (49 CFR Part 1520) for TSA-regulated pipelines; Water RRA/ERP content; Customer PII, usage/smart-meter data and payment card data
- **Critical systems:** SCADA/EMS; DCS in generating plants; Distribution management systems (ADMS/OMS); AMI/smart meters; Protective relays and substation automation (IEC 61850); Water treatment PLC/HMI; Customer information and billing systems
- **Sector AI rules and guidance:** None identified beyond cross-sector obligations
- **Assurance alternatives to SOC 2:** NERC CIP compliance audits by regional entities (mandatory for applicable entities)
- **Scenario incident (P08):** Intrusion into distribution control systems (OT)
- **Scenario AI use case (P10):** Electric load-forecasting model
